overview.summary: This plan resolves two existing Todo defects as independent, execution-sized stories. The bundle keeps the due-date persistence fix and the quick-add priority default fix on separate ownership surfaces so the stories can proceed in parallel and merge without conflict.

sharedDecisions.title: Preserve story isolation by file ownership
sharedDecisions.description: S01 owns the edit/update due-date path and its regression coverage; S02 owns create-time quick-add defaulting on non-overlapping surfaces plus separate regression coverage so the two stories stay merge-safe.

sharedDecisions.title: Keep the HTMX partial contract stable
sharedDecisions.description: Both stories must preserve HTML fragment responses and the `todo_item.html` data-attribute contract because the edit dialog is populated from the rendered row state.

sharedDecisions.title: Prefer existing patterns without forcing shared-file edits
sharedDecisions.description: Stay aligned with the current HTML-fragment and ad-hoc validation patterns, but allow S02 to satisfy defaulting at the existing persistence boundary when that is the only clean way to preserve the PRD's file-isolation constraint.

bindingConstraints.verbatim: Fix BUG-002 and BUG-003 from docs/PRODUCT-BACKLOG.md (Known Defects section) as two independent, thin stories.
Keep each story isolated to its own files; they must merge without conflict.

stories.name: Persist edit-dialog due dates
stories.scope: Persist the date selected in the Todo edit dialog through save, reload, and re-open so users see the same due date they chose. Includes the date-only input round-trip and clear-date behavior for the existing update flow; excludes overdue or due-today styling fixes from BUG-004 and any quick-add priority changes.
stories.notes: Keep regression coverage in a file S02 does not need to edit; do not widen into due-date styling semantics.

stories.name: Default quick-add priority to low
stories.scope: Ensure Todos created from the quick-add form always start with the documented `low` priority so the rendered row and subsequent edit dialog show a populated priority value immediately. Includes create-time defaulting and regression coverage for quick-add output; excludes edit-dialog due-date parsing and broader priority UX changes.
stories.notes: Keep verification out of S01's test file and prefer create-time defaulting on S02-owned surfaces so both stories remain merge-safe under the PRD constraint.

riskSummary.mitigation: Cover both save-and-reopen persistence and explicit due-date clearing so the fix cannot silently preserve stale values or reintroduce the current parse mismatch.

executionNotes: S01 and S02 may execute in parallel once ownership is claimed, but they must preserve disjoint file surfaces to satisfy the PRD isolation constraint. Re-check the rendered `todo_item.html` data attributes after each story because the edit dialog state is populated from those values.
